description: Generator for the dual tone multi-frequency pairs a telephone keypad sends, one of sixteen keys picked by pitch voltage and sounded while a gate is high

inputs.text: Picks which of the sixteen keys is sounded, a semitone per key and within 0.02V of each step: 0V gives 1, and then 2, 3, A, 4, 5, 6, B, 7, 8, 9, C, star, 0, hash and D at 1.25V
Sounds the tone while the voltage here is 1.7V or above, and silences the output below that; each fresh rising edge restarts the tone from its beginning

outputs.text: The two summed sine tones of the chosen key, and 0V whenever the gate is below 1.7V

notes: No tone sounds until a gate of 1.7V or more reaches GATE; with nothing patched there the output holds 0V.
Both tones are computed for a sample rate of 44100Hz whatever rate the engine is set to, so at any other rate the pair comes out shifted by the ratio between the two rates.
